note: Two north-shore loops at Rifle Gap Reservoir about 500 m apart: Cottonwood at the east end near the main entrance and the dump station (the park's most natural shade; close to the water in high-water years) and Cedar to the west on a rise. Cottonwood loop (electric sites incl. 6-8) sits flat on the reservoir beach/shoreline apron — the wide sand gap is drawdown, not elevation; lakefront by beach-apron rule. Cedar loop is on a rise above (lakeview). --Claude

flags: Split question: the evidence points to ONE campground, not three entries. All five Rifle Gap loops (Sage, Pinon, Cedar, Lakeview, Cottonwood) branch off a single park road (OSM 'Rifle Gap Road') along the north shore from the main entrance at the visitor center; the farthest pair (Cottonwood to Sage) are ~0.9 km apart and none has its own entrance from the highway. This entry's pairing is also geographically odd: Cottonwood sits beside Lakeview at the east end (the brochure's 1.5-mile trail 'connects Lakeview and Cottonwood campgrounds'), while Cedar sits with Sage and Pinon at the west end. CPW and cpwshop treat it as one park/one listing (parkID 50038) with five loops, 89 campsites.

Pin: 39.6329,-107.7515 is the Cedar loop's centroid (cpwshop 39.63294,-107.75145); Cottonwood's sites center on 39.63332,-107.74539, ~520 m east, so the pin is ~260 m from the two loops' combined midpoint and on neither if the entry stays a pair.
